P1.reason: A usefully splits drop legality from board bookkeeping but fractures the win rule; B keeps the win rule whole but lumps all dropping into one block.

differences.reason: Helps: board setup and cell update rules form a clear 'board state' rule.
Hurts: win/end rule includes horizontal and vertical lines but omits diagonal lines, which sit elsewhere.
Helps: legal drops, landing and gravity form a recognisable 'how you drop a counter' rule.
Hurts: adjacency plus horizontal and diagonal lines, cut off from line aggregation and the winning condition.
Hurts somewhat: one oversized block merges legality, gravity, cell updates and initial board.
Helps: all line detection, game end and winning together form one coherent win rule.
